content.text:
I'm writing this down so I remember it when my son calls.

**Screen 1.**
- "הראל" in big letters. I know that name, it's a big company, so good.
- "דמי הניהול הם הממוצע שנגבה בפועל ב־2025". That's what they take. Good, that's one of the things I wanted to know.
- A row of buttons: "קופת גמל להשקעה 16" is lit up. That's what I came for, so it's the right place.
- "16 מסלולים · דמי ניהול החיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%". About half a percent of the money, and "0% מההפקדות". All the companies take something, so that doesn't sound too bad.
- First row, "אשראי ואג"ח". I know אג"ח. But next to it there's "פחות מ־3 שנים" where I expected a number. So I don't know how it did.
- "מניות סחיר", 96% מניות. No, not shares.
- The page is dark with lots of numbers and little coloured circles. I don't understand the circles.

**Screen 2.**
- Too many numbers. Going slowly from the right.
- "עוקב מדד S&P 500", 13.7%. That's a big number. But it has English letters and 99% מניות. That's gambling, so not for me.
- "אג"ח סחיר": 0% מניות and 0% מט"ח. That sounds safe. But again "פחות מ־3 שנים", so no number.
- "כספי (שקלי)": 0% מניות, 0% מט"ח, "3 שנים 4.25%", "5 שנים 3.08%". "שקלי" means shekels, my own money, nothing foreign. 4.25% a year, more than I remember getting on the deposit, I think.
- 67 מיליון ₪ in it. That's not a lot next to the 2.3 billion, but it's not nothing either.
- "קיימות", 93% מניות. No.
- "אשראי ואג"ח עם מניות (עד 25% מניות)", 8.6%. But it has shares, so no.

**Screen 3.**
- The end of the table. A small grey line: "התקרה בחוק: 1.05% מהחיסכון, 4% מההפקדות". So Harel takes about half of what the law allows. Good.
- Another small grey line about "עמלות מסחר". I couldn't read it properly.
- "התשואה היא תשואת עבר… היא לא אומרת מה יקרה בהמשך". Right, I know that.
- After that, a list of folds: "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל". I'm not opening them. I'm tired.

**Screen 4.** Just the same list again and a search box. I've stopped here.

---

**What I'd tell my son:**
"Listen, I looked at Harel. If anything, I'd take the **'כספי (שקלי)'** track. It has no shares, no foreign currency, it's all in shekels, and it shows 4.25% a year over three years. The fee is about half a percent of the money and nothing on what you put in. That's half of what the law allows, it said so. The 13.7% one has English letters and is all shares, so I didn't even think about it. But I'm not putting money in before you or the bank tell me whether 4.25% is really better than my deposit after the fee. And I don't really know what 'כספי' means there. Some of the safe-looking ones, like 'אג"ח סחיר', just say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no number. The screen was dark, full of numbers and little circles, and the grey writing at the bottom was very hard to read."
